item.text: {"actions":[{"action":"Show an outcome for every file","mechanism":"Per-file states distinguish accepted receipts, definite failures, pending uploads, and outcomes that remain unknown.","implementation":"Render five attachment slots with filename, text status, and relevant controls. Mark acceptance only after receiving a stable server receipt.","check":"Simulate two acceptances, two failures, and one timeout; verify each has the correct status and next step.","risk":"A timeout must not appear as a definite rejection."},{"action":"Retry only files that need another upload","mechanism":"Selective retry preserves accepted receipts instead of restarting the entire batch or resubmitting the form.","implementation":"Offer individual retry and “Retry failed files.” Reuse in-memory files while available; otherwise request reselection. Exclude accepted and unresolved entries.","check":"Fail three of five uploads, then retry; network logs must show no retransmission of the two accepted files.","risk":"Reselected files may differ; require users to confirm replacements."},{"action":"Resolve uncertain outcomes before offering another upload","mechanism":"Receipt reconciliation distinguishes a lost response from an upload the server never accepted.","implementation":"Add anonymous, scoped upload-attempt lookup around existing processing. Associate attempt tokens with resulting receipts; after timeout, query before enabling retry.","check":"Drop an acceptance response; reconciliation must recover its receipt without retransmitting bytes. Unresolved attempts must remain visibly unresolved.","risk":"Requires coordination metadata, not changes to file processing."},{"action":"Explain recovery when the tab reopens","mechanism":"Receipt-based restoration recovers accepted attachments without retaining file bytes or pretending failed selections remain available.","implementation":"Persist only opaque receipts with a 24-hour lifetime. Resolve valid receipts into attachment rows; explain that unfinished selections require reselection. Discard expired recovery entries.","check":"Close after partial acceptance and reopen: accepted files return without uploads; missing selections are explained. Expired receipts cannot restore the browser draft.","risk":"Unavailable storage or cleared receipts prevents automatic recovery."},{"action":"Make removal and replacement explicit","mechanism":"Attachment slots separate user intent from upload completion, preventing late responses from undoing removal or exceeding five files.","implementation":"Give each slot a version. Replacing or removing invalidates that version; ignore late results for the final list. Count pending slots toward five.","check":"Remove a pending file, add its replacement, then deliver the old receipt; the removed attachment must stay excluded.","risk":"Excluding a receipt does not imply deleting its server file."},{"action":"Require review of the exact final list","mechanism":"A separate review checkpoint prevents unresolved or silently omitted attachments from becoming an accidental final submission.","implementation":"Show the ordered accepted attachment list and count. Require explicit exclusion of unresolved entries and final confirmation; invalidate confirmation whenever attachments change.","check":"Change an attachment after reviewing: submission must require review again. An unresolved entry must block submission until resolved or explicitly excluded.","risk":"Do not imply that reviewing names verifies file contents."},{"action":"Make repeated case submission recover the same case","mechanism":"Atomic finalization makes double-clicks and lost submission responses return an existing case rather than create duplicates.","implementation":"Group upload receipts under an anonymous draft. Finalize that draft once; repeated finalization returns its case receipt. Receipt recovery also reports whether submission already completed.","check":"Send concurrent submissions and drop the first response; retry and reopen must identify one case, without uploading accepted files again.","risk":"Requires case-creation coordination and securely scoped anonymous recovery."}],"abstention_reason":""}
